abilities.name: Ceremonial Crystalshot
abilities.description:
When a character in the party obtains an Elemental Shard created from the Crystallize reaction, or when they trigger the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, Navia will gain 1 Crystal Shrapnel stack. Navia can have up to 6 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel at once. Each time Crystal Shrapnel gain is triggered, the duration of the Crystal Shrapnel stacks you already have will be reset. Through the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, Navia will gain up to 1 Crystal Shrapnel stack every second.
When she fires, Navia will consume all Crystal Shrapnel stacks and open her elegant yet lethal Gunbrella, firing multiple Rosula Shardshots that can penetrate opponents, dealing Geo DMG to opponents hit.
When 0/1/2/3 or more stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed, 5/7/9/11 Rosula Shardshots will be fired respectively. The more Rosula Shardshots that strike a single opponent, the greater the DMG dealt to them. When all 11 Rosula Shardshots strike, 200% of the original amount of DMG is dealt.
In addition, when more than 3 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed, every stack consumed beyond those 3 will increase the DMG dealt by this Gunbrella attack by an additional 15%.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode, continually collecting nearby Elemental Shards created by Crystallize reactions. When released, fire Rosula Shardshots with the same effect as when the skill is Tapped.

Two initial charges.

Arkhe: Ousia
Periodically, when Navia fires her Gunbrella, a Surging Blade will be summoned, dealing Ousia-aligned Geo DMG.
_curatorNotes: Skill has two frame sets per mode based on shrapnel count (0–2 vs ≥3 shrapnel). Base Press frames above use 0–2 shrapnel set (skillFrames[0][0]). ≥3 shrapnel Press frames: swap=40, N=40, D=26, J=24 (skillFrames[0][1]). Reviewer to decide which to record or whether to add a variant.

Hold variant frames above use min-hold (p["hold"]=1, internal hold=0), 0–2 shrapnel (skillFrames[1][0]). ≥3 shrapnel Hold frames (min-hold): swap=71, D=56, J=56 — N not explicitly set in gcsim at ≥3 shrapnel Hold → omitted.

Hold variant is parametric: all cancel frame values increase by hold duration (internal hold = p["hold"]-1, capped at 240f). Max internal hold = 240f (skillMaxHoldDuration=241, subtract 1). At max hold all frame values +240f. cooldownStartDelay for Hold = firingTime = skillHoldCDStart(41) + internal_hold; schema gap: AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field — reviewer to extend schema if needed.
Removed generator duration:300 — Crystal Shrapnel stack duration is a resource mechanic (gcsim comment: 'way too long to bother'), not a summon or persistent ability window.
Removed generator tags:["summon"] — the skill fires projectiles and spawns no persistent summon entity.
Surging Blade (Arkhe: Ousia): delayed one-shot proc registered at 28f after cast, damage at +36f (total 64f from cast). ICD: 7s (arkheICDKey). Not a persistent summon — no summons[] entry authored.

Surging Blade applies NOTHING (2026-09-17, T1.5): gcsim skill.go surgingBlade is `Durability: 0`, so its +75 (tap) and +105 (hold) entries are gone from both `application` lists. They had been masked only by the per-cast ICD counter suppressing the second entry — the frames report's `[icd]` tag cannot tell that from a no-Durability hit.

abilities.name: As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute

_curatorNotes: gcsim internal/characters/navia/burst.go Burst(): the QueueCharTask at burstDelay=154 queues Tasks.Add at offsets i, and each QueueAttack uses travel=9, so the first cannon hit lands at 154+0+9=163f from cast start. firstTickDelay = (163 − spawnsAt 154) / 60 = 0.15s.

Interval = the modal gap. gcsim's loop alternates 42/42/48f (tick%3==2 → nextTick=48, else 42); two of every three gaps are 42f, so interval = 42/60 = 0.7s. Our schema has one interval per series, so the authored cadence runs ~30f (0.5s) ahead of gcsim by the 17th tick. Tick count matches: (12 − 0.15) / 0.7 → 17 ticks, and the gcsim-frames-diff row observes 17.

scaling: gcsim zz_navia.dm.go burst[1] ("Cannon Fire Support DMG") index 9 = 0.7767 → 77.67%. Sidecar docs/curation/talents/navia.json talents.burst row "Cannon Fire Support DMG" L10 = 77.7% (rounded); gcsim's unrounded value preferred.
stat: ai.Mult is the only scaling on the AttackInfo and there is no snap modification, so it is plain ATK.

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b), superseding the note that said the group could not be expressed: ICDGroupNaviaBurst's table entry (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) is a 720f reset window with every 3rd hit applying. Measured 6/17 applied against standard ICD's 9. ⚓ The 12s window is longer than the burst itself, so the counter never gets a reset mid-burst — the TIMER is what makes the difference here, not the period, which is standard's own.
Durability 25 on the tick AttackInfo → 1U, the schema default for a summon tick series.

abilities.description:
On the orders of the President of the Spina di Rosula, call for a magnificent Rosula Dorata Salute. Unleashes a massive cannon bombardment on opponents in front of her, dealing AoE Geo DMG and providing Cannon Fire Support for a duration afterward, periodically dealing Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
When cannon attacks hit opponents, Navia will gain 1 stack of Crystal Shrapnel. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2.4s.
_curatorNotes: Cannon Fire Support mobility omitted: in gcsim it targets random enemies within 10m of player position (player-proximal, not a fixed world point or literally caster-attached). Reviewer to decide 'stationary' vs 'follows' or omit.
Cannon Fire Support tick pattern: first tick at burstDelay=154f, then alternates 42/42/48f intervals (tick%3==2 → 48f, else 42f) for the full 720f = 12s window.
Initial cannon blast (burstHitmark=104f) is the main burst damage instance, separate from the Cannon Fire Support summon.
Removed generator duration:12 — moved to summons[0].duration per recipe convention.

2026-08-17 (L5e curation): authored the Cannon Fire Support tick series on summons[0].effects. C2 fires ONE extra Cannon Fire Support shot when Ceremonial Crystalshot hits (gcsim cons.go, c2IcdKey, once per E use) — that is an E-triggered shot, not a change to the burst summon's timer, so the C0 cadence is authored unconditionally and the C2 extra shot stays unmodelled.

passives.name: Undisclosed Distribution Channels
passives.description: For 4s after using Ceremonial Crystalshot, the DMG dealt by Navia's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks will be converted into Geo DMG which cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and the DMG dealt by Navia's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks will be increased by 40%.
_curatorNotes: AUTHORED 2026-09-17 (T1.5). gcsim navia.go Snapshot(): while a1Key is live, Normal/Extra/Plunge attacks take `ai.Element = Geo` and +40% DMG; asc.go sets a1Key for 60*4 frames at the skill's firingTime (11f tap, 41f + hold). An `infuse` plus the per-class DMG bonuses, the Kazuha C6 shape. Before this every swing she made was Physical and applied nothing, so a Navia rotation made no Crystallize off her own normals.

⚠️ 'cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions': our infusion rule is NEWEST grant wins, so a Bennett C6 or Candace burst cast inside the 4s would take the swing. The window opens at the cast rather than the firing time (11f / 41f+).

passives.name: Mutual Assistance Network
passives.description: For each Pyro/Electro/Cryo/Hydro party member, Navia gains 20% increased ATK. This effect can stack up to 2 times.
_curatorNotes: `manual` → `passive`, as two tiers (2026-09-17, T1.5). gcsim asc.go a4: a permanent 0.2 × min(2, count of Pyro/Electro/Cryo/Hydro party members) ATK% mod set at init. teamElementCount counts non-holder members and Navia is Geo, so the count is exactly gcsim's. ⚠️ Both tiers share `stat: atk%` and the passes dedupe by stat BEFORE conditions — the ≥2 tier is authored FIRST and the two conditions are mutually exclusive, the Iansan mitigation.
passives.caveat: Both tiers are listed as always active; in game Navia gets +20% ATK with one Pyro, Electro, Cryo or Hydro party member and +40% with two.

constellations.name: A Lady's Rules for Keeping a Courteous Distance
constellations.description: Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed when Navia uses Ceremonial Crystalshot will restore 3 Energy to her and decrease the CD of As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute by 1s. Up to 9 Energy can be gained this way, and the CD of "As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute" can be decreased by up to 3s.
_curatorNotes: No effects skeleton in generator. C1 fires per shrapnel stack consumed on E cast (up to 3 stacks): restores 3 Energy and reduces Q CD by 1s per stack. Complex per-stack trigger — not a simple onCast buff. In gcsim: c.ReduceActionCooldown + c.AddEnergy called with count=min(shrapnel,3). Reviewer to decide effect representation (energy type + cdReset type, or custom handling).

constellations.name: The President's Pursuit of Victory
constellations.description:
Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed will increase the CRIT Rate of this Ceremonial Crystalshot instance by 12%. CRIT Rate can be increased by up to 36% in this way.
In addition, when Ceremonial Crystalshot hits an opponent, one Cannon Fire Support shot from As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute will strike near the location of the hit. Up to one instance of Cannon Fire Support can be triggered each time Ceremonial Crystalshot is used, and DMG dealt by said Cannon Fire Support this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual triggers. In gcsim: snapshot modifier adding 0.12 × min(count, 3) CR to the E cast snapshot — not a persistent buff. The two effect skeletons (value:12 and value:36) appear to represent per-stack value and max-cap; reviewer to reconcile into a single effect or constellationScaling shape.

C2 secondary effect: when E hits an enemy, fires one Cannon Fire Support shot (ICD: 0.25s per E use, c2IcdKey). Not authored in effects — reviewer to handle. This C2 shot also triggers C4 resShred (c.c4()) and burstCB (Crystal Shrapnel gain at 2.4s ICD).

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 — The President's Pursuit of Victory — effects[0] (buff, critRate 12) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `navia/skill.go:238-254` — `addShrapnelBuffs` mutates the CAST'S SNAPSHOT (`snap.Stats[attributes.CR] += 0.12 × min(count,3)`, lines 245-247), called at `skill.go:160` inside the Gunbrella firing task. It is not a `StatMod`, has no duration, and expires with that one snapshot. Retained: `description` keeps both halves of the C2. Retain the gcsim reading (snapshot-only, `0.12 × min(shrapnel, 3)`, cap 36%) and record the ruling: the bonus is scoped to one instance of one ability, `critRate` is a character-wide stat with no ability scope, the buff has no duration (every `buffWindows` pool filters `duration == null`), and the damage it modifies is a number the tool never prints — so there is no honest bar. Drop "reviewer to reconcile into a single effect or constellationScaling shape". ⚠️ A `perStack` re-authoring (`key: crystalShrapnel`, `per: 12`, `maxStacks: 3`) is technically expressible but needs an INVENTED duration and would print a character-wide +36% CRIT Rate bar spanning seconds — a strict over-claim of exactly the shape the brief names. Also: Navia has no `gainStacks` author for Crystal Shrapnel, so the `stacks` key does not exist.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 — The President's Pursuit of Victory — effects[1] (buff, critRate 36) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `navia/skill.go:246` — there is no second modifier; 36 is the arithmetic ceiling of `0.12 × min(count, 3)`, never a separate grant. Retained: Record in `_curatorNotes` that the 36 skeleton was a SCHEMA ARTIFACT — the generator read the sentence's cap as a second value — so the pair was never two effects. The curator note's own sentence ("appear to represent per-stack value and max-cap") is the evidence; keep it and mark it resolved. ⚠️ Two effects on the same `stat` on the same host — had either survived, the cast pool's stat dedupe would have silently kept whichever was authored first and the tool would have printed one of 12%/36% arbitrarily. Both go.

constellations.name: The Flexible Finesse of the Spina's President
constellations.description: If more than 3 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed when using Ceremonial Crystalshot, each stack consumed beyond the first 3 increases the CRIT DMG of that Ceremonial Crystalshot by 45%, and any stacks consumed beyond the first 3 are returned to Navia.
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. In gcsim: snapshot modifier adding 0.45 × max(shrapnel-3, 0) CD per excess stack at E cast time — not a persistent buff. Value:45 represents per-excess-stack amount. C6 also returns excess shrapnel after firing (shrapnel = max(shrapnel-3, 0)). Reviewer to decide representation for snapshot mechanic and shrapnel-return interaction.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 — The Flexible Finesse of the Spina's President — effects[0] (buff, critDmg 45) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `navia/skill.go:248-250` — `snap.Stats[attributes.CD] += 0.45 × max(count−3, 0)`, the same cast-snapshot mutation as C2, no `StatMod` and no duration. The shrapnel return is `skill.go:204` (`c.shrapnel = max(c.shrapnel-3, 0)`). Retained: `description` keeps it. Retain the gcsim reading (per-EXCESS-stack 45% CD on the E snapshot, plus the excess-shrapnel return) and record the same ruling as C2: instance-scoped snapshot, `critDmg` is character-wide, no duration, and the damage it modifies is never printed. Drop "reviewer to decide representation". ⚠️ The authored `value: 45` reads as a flat +45% CRIT DMG buff — the worst version of this over-claim, since it is per-excess-stack and reaches +135% at 6 shrapnel. Retiring it removes a number that was wrong in both directions.
